messages.subject: Embedding Shiny Apps/Interactive RMarkdown with Shiny into an LMS
parts:
Hi all,

Has anyone had experience of putting Shiny content into Blackboard/Moodle/Canvas?  How did you do it?

I have been trying different approaches.  The best I have been able to do it put my interactive document on shinyapps.io and then use an iframe call in Moodle to embed it but it seems to do funny things to the dimensions.  Does anyone have any other clever ways (or tips) for integrating Shiny content into an LMS?

cheers
